item.title: Ce géant de roche fonce vers nous : en frôlant la Terre en 2029, c'est pourtant lui qui va se faire secouer
item.description: En 2029, un astéroïde doit s'approcher de la Terre, mais s'il ne présente aucun risque pour nous, l'inverse n'est pas forcément sûr. Les scientifiques craignent que ce passage ne lui soit fatal.

item.title: Tyson Foods beef plant closures come as severe drought makes U.S. cattle shortages worse
item.description: The food processing giant has long warned investors about the risks of extreme weather. Those risks have arrived. This week, Tyson Foods announced that it is restructuring its beef business, closing or selling three of its facilities as it deals with “one of the most historic cattle shortages the country has ever experienced.”

item.title: J’ai testé un climatiseur corporel de Sony : ça marche bien contre la canicule, mais exige de réels compromis
item.description: Les vagues de chaleur se répètent et les fabricants multiplient les objets censés nous rafraîchir en déplacement. Sony creuse la même idée depuis 2019 : une plaque thermique posée sur la peau, à la base de la nuque, plutôt qu'un ventilateur qui brasse de l'air chaud. J'ai testé le Reon Pocket Pro Plus.

item.title: From daylight saving to calendars, here’s how our ways of measuring time came to be
item.description: Measurements of time are made up and political. It flies. It heals all wounds. It can be of the essence, and it can be money. We thrill in the best of it, lament the worst. We’re warned not to waste it, since we can’t turn it back — even as we try to make up for when it’s lost.And probably more than anything when it comes to time, most of us try to manage it — in our everyday lives and on a global scale, from the biology of our circadian rhythms to what constitutes a work day. item.title: Luigi Mangione pleads guilty to federal stalking charges in UnitedHealthcare CEO killing
item.description: Mangione is set for sentencing Dec. 18. Luigi Mangione pleaded guilty on Friday to federal stalking charges in the killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson, admitting matter-of-factly that he trailed the executive to an investor conference in 2024 and gunned him down on a New York City street.
